errors.text: The proposed Ti2Ni, TiFe, or TiNi precipitates are speculative and replace the target C14 Laves phase without evidence that they provide the required magnetic coupling or anisotropy.

A 0-200 Oe measurement range is insufficient for reliable characterization of a material expected to have coercivity potentially several hundred Oe and cannot establish saturation magnetization or loop squareness.
Measurements only up to 400 K cannot verify the claimed Curie temperature above 500 K, much less identify the target high-temperature transition near 1084 K.
The cited evidence does not support Ti-rich intermetallic precipitation, interfacial orbital-moment enhancement, or the proposed fcc/intermetallic exchange coupling.
